verses.text: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.

xrefs.text: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.

verses.text: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

xrefs.text: But let him who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows Me, that I am the LORD, who exercises loving devotion, justice and righteousness on the earth— for I delight in these things,” declares the LORD.
Therefore, as it is written: “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
In the LORD all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult.

verses.text: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

xrefs.text: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
Then Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord,
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!
May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”

verses.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

xrefs.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

verses.text: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.

xrefs.text: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.
For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

verses.text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.

xrefs.text: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

verses.text: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.

xrefs.text: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, for I was found innocent in His sight, and I have done no wrong against you, O king.”
Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
And that very night the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the Assyrians. When the people got up the next morning, there were all the dead bodies!

Then Elisha prayed, “O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see.” And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw that the hills were full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

verses.text: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!

xrefs.text: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,
Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
I will fill the souls of the priests abundantly, and will fill My people with My goodness,” declares the LORD.
My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

verses.text: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.

xrefs.text: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

verses.text: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

xrefs.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.
The lion may roar, and the fierce lion may growl, yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.

verses.text: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

xrefs.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,
I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
Whom is He trying to teach? To whom is He explaining His message? To infants just weaned from milk? To babies removed from the breast?

verses.text: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?

xrefs.text: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.

and that you may love the LORD your God, obey Him, and hold fast to Him. For He is your life, and He will prolong your life in the land that the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”

so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.
With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.

verses.text: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.

xrefs.text: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress.
“He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”
My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,

verses.text: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

xrefs.text: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.

verses.text: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.

xrefs.text: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
He does not take His eyes off the righteous, but He enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.
O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

verses.text: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.

xrefs.text: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I will set My face to bring disaster and to cut off all Judah.
O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who abandon You will be put to shame. All who turn away will be written in the dust, for they have abandoned the LORD, the fountain of living water.
If anyone from the house of Israel or a foreigner living among them eats any blood, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people.
The memory of him perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the land.

verses.text: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.

xrefs.text: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.

verses.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

xrefs.text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.

For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.

The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

verses.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

xrefs.text: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!

verses.text: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.

xrefs.text: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, for I was found innocent in His sight, and I have done no wrong against you, O king.”

verses.text: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.

xrefs.text: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
Woe to the wicked; disaster is upon them! For they will be repaid with what their hands have done.
For though a righteous man may fall seven times, he still gets up; but the wicked stumble in bad times.
They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

verses.text: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.

xrefs.text: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
